camera_unavailable: Camera unavailable. Close other camera apps and retry.
frame_unavailable: Camera frame unavailable. Reconnect the camera and retry.
encoding_failed: Could not process this camera frame.
window: Face test: SPACE to capture; ESC to cancel
genuine_ready: Enrolled participant {number}: return for a separate capture, then press Enter.
attempt: Capture processed in {seconds}s. No images or face patterns saved.
intro: Temporary evaluation only. Face data stays in memory. Only aggregate counts, timing, model metadata and candidate thresholds are saved. This tool does not issue coupons.
review_consent: Have you reviewed docs/CONSENT_TEMPLATE.md and explained it to participants? [yes/no]
not_started: Evaluation not started; camera not opened.
too_few: Not enough consenting participants to evaluate.
calibration: Calibration captures: use new frames, not the enrollment frames. Include people who did not enroll.
no_candidate: No usable threshold recommendation from these captures. Report will record this; collect better or more representative samples.
candidate: Candidate thresholds only: MEDIUM={medium}, HIGH={high}. These are not approved pilot settings.
validation: Now validate with fresh captures. Keep the gallery fixed and do not adjust thresholds. Use different unknown people if available. Press Enter to begin.
report: Aggregate report saved to {path}. Review candidate thresholds and validation results. M1 acceptance remains pending.
cancelled: Evaluation cancelled. No report written; temporary face data discarded.
